run_f_gold: run f_gold with a sequence string like 'DIDI' to get the minimum number digits
test_f_gold: test f_gold against multiple DI sequences and compare results to expected output
summarize_f_gold: summarize how f_gold builds the minimum number from an increase-decrease pattern string
review_f_gold: review f_gold algorithm that assigns digits in decreasing runs between increase markers
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to return a string instead of a list of integer digits
